case.presentation: 64 year old with no significant past medical history presents with a 9mm, solid, spiculated nodule in the left upper lobe.
case.context: Patient initially presented for productive cough, no other imaging at this institution.

ground_truth.notes: Baseline imaging finding from MacMahon 2017 Fig 6 (solid, spiculated, LUL); figure caption notes surgical pathology of invasive adenocarcinoma — dropped as outcome leakage. Patient context fabricated. Maintainer-assigned high risk per Fleischner §'Risk Estimation' listing spiculated margins and upper-lobe location as high-risk factors; oracle's smoking-only heuristic flags this never-smoker as low risk. Table 1A single solid >8mm is risk-invariant — both low and high route to CONSIDER_PET_OR_BIOPSY — so the disagreement is informative but doesn't change the recommendation.
